notes: Table2to5.do lines 147-157: preserve; drop if EUWeb==0; drop if after_gdpr==0; bys id_web: egen anycm=sum(ConsentMechanism); reghdfe reach_per_million ConsentMechanism if anycm>0, absorb(i.wave_num i.id_web) cluster(id_web). Outcome: Alexa reach per million. Published value from the article (see published_source); the six-column layout is confirmed by the article (the shipped do-file resets global dvs to url_gdelt before Table 5, so it produces only column 1). Sample: 316 EU websites, waves 26-34 (post-GDPR), 2,838 site-waves (2,247 non-missing for url_gdelt and reaction_mean). Treatment = ConsentMechanism (1 if the site displays a cookie-consent mechanism in that wave). g_t5 = first wave in 26-34 with ConsentMechanism==1: 118 websites at wave 26 (always treated in this window; 50 of them in every wave), 198 switch on at waves 27-34 (8 cohorts); no never-treated units. 373 post-adoption site-waves have the indicator switched off and are dropped via sample_filter (Hull fn 6); on the retained rows 1[wave>=g_t5]==ConsentMechanism. gvar is used instead of treat_var so that adoption is dated from the treatment path rather than from rows with non-missing outcome. Because of the switch-off drop the runner TWFE differs from the published coefficient by construction (check against fixest on the trimmed sample); fixest on the same trimmed sample gives -6.56443 (SE 11.451), N 2463 after singletons.
